title: Becky Lynch becomes The Man
summary: Frustration with Charlotte turns Becky into an uncompromising challenger. The rivalry expands toward Ronda Rousey and the first women’s WrestleMania main event.

chapters.title: Becky turns on Charlotte
chapters.result: Lynch attacks Flair after losing the triple-threat title match.
chapters.context: The post-match attack marks the break between the former friends.

chapters.title: Becky is the Last Woman Standing
chapters.result: Lynch retains the SmackDown Women’s title against Charlotte.
chapters.context: The title feud reaches a punishing stipulation match.

chapters.title: Becky takes both championships
chapters.result: Lynch defeats Ronda Rousey and Charlotte Flair in the winner-take-all main event.
chapters.context: Becky leaves with both the Raw and SmackDown Women’s titles.
